description: The finite-root Torelli theorem is complete; the remaining compactification problem is to glue it across strata where deleted roots escape to infinity.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an audited LaTeX locator for every defining claim.

members.statement: Extend the finite-root all-multiplicity classification across strata where deleted roots escape to c=infinity and the number of finite marked planes changes.
members.title: Glue Cubic-Frame Torelli Across Roots Escaping to Infinity

members.statement: For admissible cubic frames with nonconstant A/c, stable left-right equivalence, ordinary left-right equivalence, and equality of the decorated Artin schemes (Spec C[c]/(A/c), B mod (A/c)) up to scaling are equivalent, without squarefreeness or coprimality assumptions.
members.title: All-Multiplicity Fixed-Frame Torelli

source_treatment: The linked working manuscript has audited locators for every defining claim on this page.
statement: Compactify the all-multiplicity cubic-frame classification across degenerations in which deleted roots move to \(c=\infty\), so the number of finite marked planes changes, and compare the resulting boundary with the \(\alpha=0\) stratum.
title: Gluing Cubic-Frame Torelli at Infinity
